one_line: Do not bid now: this is a workshop discussion of an unfunded need, with no restroom solicitation or request for responses.
scope: Trumbull County discussed extending portable-toilet rental and cleaning or servicing at trail facilities in Ohio. An extra month and year-round service were discussed, but no expansion, duration, site count, or funding was approved.
fit: Portable sanitation, restroom rentals, cleaning, pump-outs, maintenance, and waste disposal match company competencies.
Nationwide coverage includes Ohio; Denver restroom-trailer work provides relevant past performance.
No set-aside is stated, so no stated restriction conflicts with the company's SBE/MBE status.
Company PSCs W023, W099, W045 and GSA SINs 532490P, 561210FS, 561210FAC, 541614 provide related coverage, but this notice states no PSC or GSA purchasing requirement.
red_flags: The record is classified as Agendas / Minutes, not a solicitation, sources sought, or RFI.
The attachment contains YouTube captions expressly labeled as unofficial meeting minutes.
Budget constraints caused early toilet removal; additional funding remains unresolved.
Discussion concerns porta-johns; standard portable-toilet inventory is not established by the company's documented restroom-trailer fleet.
Notice NAICS 562991 is absent from the company's supplied NAICS list.
No specifications, submission instructions, procurement contact, or evaluation criteria are supplied.
competition: No incumbent, past restroom awardee, or offer count is identified. The supplied agency award search and broader benchmark search returned zero results; competition cannot be assessed.
price_signal: No comparable trailhead award price is supplied. The $131,000 received and $136,000 requested were overall parks budgets, not restroom contract values. Denver restroom-trailer past performance has an unresolved printed value of '~$100,00.00'; the $78,500 USCG award included housing and sanitation and is not a direct comparison. The price list provides no confirmed standard porta-john rate.
must_have: No restroom submission items or hard requirements are established in the supplied record. Source: bid pack Opportunity and workshop attachment.
Mandatory site visits, bonding, licenses, and insurance requirements are not stated and cannot be treated as waived. Source: supplied workshop attachment.
The November 20, 2026, 2:00 p.m. deadline applies to the separate Rural Water Facilities Project. Source: workshop attachment, 00:28:06–00:28:38.
